## Review before polish

- [ ] The mechanism is visible without reading a derivation.
- [ ] English and Korean have the same claims and similar explanation depth.
- [ ] A static alternative allows slow reading of every animated scene.
- [ ] Original visuals and licensed dependencies; no copied paper figures.
- [ ] Cloud numeric/render checks and visual inspection completed.
- [ ] Owner reviewed the actual revision: reference, date and requested changes.
